async function runReadCallerFixtures(createSafeReadCaller) {
  const passed = [];
  let stubCalls = 0;
  function check(value, message) {
    if (!value) throw new Error(message);
  }
  function rejects(call, code) {
    let caught = null;
    try { call(); } catch (error) { caught = error; }
    check(caught !== null && caught.code === code, "expected rejection: " + code);
  }
  {
    const captured = [];
    const sentinel = Object.freeze({stub: "entry-result"});
    const caller = createSafeReadCaller(request => {
      captured.push(request); stubCalls += 1; return sentinel;
    }, ["D:/synthetic/read-lines.cmd"]);
    const plan = caller.prepareRead("D:/synthetic/report.py", 11, 20, 7200);
    check(captured.length === 0, "prepare must not invoke callback");
    check(caller.validatePlan(plan) === plan.request, "validate returns exact request");
    check(captured.length === 0, "validate must not invoke callback");
    check(await caller.read("D:/synthetic/report.py", 11, 20, 7200) === sentinel,
      "read must preserve callback result");
    check(captured.length === 1, "read entry must invoke callback once");
    const request = captured[0];
    check(Object.keys(request).sort().join(",") === "cmd,login,max_output_tokens,shell",
      "only exact exec fields may reach callback");
    check(request.cmd === "D:/synthetic/read-lines.cmd D:/synthetic/report.py 11 20"
      && request.shell === "cmd.exe" && request.login === false
      && request.max_output_tokens === 7200 && Object.isFrozen(request),
      "actual callback args differ from literal expectation");
    passed.push("entry-to-final-exec-args");
  }
  {
    const prefix = ["D:/synthetic/read-lines.cmd"];
    const caller = createSafeReadCaller(() => { stubCalls += 1; }, prefix);
    prefix[0] = "D:/synthetic/changed.cmd";
    const plan = caller.prepareRead("D:/synthetic/data.json", 1, 300);
    check(plan.argv[0] === "D:/synthetic/read-lines.cmd", "prefix input mutation leaked");
    check(Object.isFrozen(caller) && Object.isFrozen(plan) && Object.isFrozen(plan.argv)
      && Object.isFrozen(plan.readerPrefix) && Object.isFrozen(plan.request), "mutable plan field");
    check(caller.validatePlan(plan).cmd ===
      "D:/synthetic/read-lines.cmd D:/synthetic/data.json 1 300", "prefix/range drift");
    for (const bad of [[], ["D:/synthetic/read.py"], ["D:/synthetic/read.exe"],
      ["D:/synthetic/read-lines.cmd", "extra"], ["D:/../read.cmd"], ["D:/a&b/read.cmd"]]) {
      rejects(() => createSafeReadCaller(() => {}, bad), "INVALID_PREFIX");
    }
    passed.push("captured-prefix-and-immutable-plan");
  }
  {
    let calls = 0;
    const callback = () => { calls += 1; stubCalls += 1; return "recovered"; };
    const caller = createSafeReadCaller(callback, ["D:/synthetic/read-lines.cmd"]);
    const other = createSafeReadCaller(callback, ["D:/synthetic/read-lines.cmd"]);
    const cycle = {}; cycle.plan = cycle;
    const getter = {};
    Object.defineProperty(getter, "request", {get() { throw new Error("getter must not run"); }});
    for (const value of [cycle, getter, null, other.prepareRead("D:/synthetic/data.md", 1, 1)]) {
      rejects(() => caller.validatePlan(value), "UNRECOGNIZED_PLAN");
    }
    check(calls === 0, "rejected plan invoked callback");
    check(await caller.read("D:/synthetic/data.md", 1, 1) === "recovered" && calls === 1,
      "cyclic/foreign rejection poisoned later valid state");
    passed.push("cyclic-foreign-rejection-then-valid-entry");
  }
  {
    const captured = [];
    const caller = createSafeReadCaller(request => {
      captured.push(request); stubCalls += 1;
    }, ["D:/synthetic/read-lines.cmd"]);
    for (const extension of ["py", "java", "json", "md"]) {
      await caller.read("D:/synthetic/data." + extension, 1, 1);
      check(captured[captured.length - 1].cmd ===
        "D:/synthetic/read-lines.cmd D:/synthetic/data." + extension + " 1 1",
        "data extension changed executable slot");
    }
    const count = captured.length;
    const cycle = {}; cycle.self = cycle;
    const noCoercion = {valueOf() { throw new Error("must not coerce range"); }};
    rejects(() => caller.read(cycle, 1, 1), "INVALID_PATH");
    rejects(() => caller.read("D:/synthetic/data.md", noCoercion, 1), "INVALID_RANGE");
    rejects(() => caller.read("D:/synthetic/data.md", 1, 301), "INVALID_RANGE");
    rejects(() => caller.read("D:/synthetic/data.md", 1, 1, true), "INVALID_OUTPUT");
    for (const path of ["D:/synthetic/NUL.json", "1:/synthetic/data.json",
      "D:/synthetic//data.json", "D:/synthetic/data.json/", "D:/synthetic/data.json:stream",
      "D:/synthetic/data.json\n"]) {
      rejects(() => caller.read(path, 1, 1), "INVALID_PATH");
    }
    check(captured.length === count, "rejected entry reached callback");
    passed.push("data-slot-and-invalid-entry-no-exec");
  }
  return {newCases: passed.length, passed, capturingStubCalls: stubCalls,
    actualToolCalls: 0, networkCalls: 0, oldPythonTestsRun: 0};
}
